name: QPrey: Escape from Lake Thing
source: Set in fictional foxes flu pandemic era, young college teen and his brother's fiancee, quarantine themselves at solitary lake house in the middle of nowhere. Little did they know, the lake holds sinister secret that will forever change their lives. In order to survive, they need to cast their difference aside and worked together to survive whatever lurks in the depth of the lake.​
translation: 故事发生在虚构的狐狸流感大流行时期。一名年轻大学生与哥哥的未婚妻，来到偏僻无人之地的一座湖边小屋中隔离。他们并不知道，湖中隐藏着一个邪恶的秘密，将永远改变两人的人生。为了活下去，他们必须放下分歧，携手面对潜伏在湖底的未知之物。
